title: Career Journey & Milestones
subtitle: A chronological timeline of roles, companies, and platforms shipped: from full-stack engineering to technical leadership across fintech, enterprise logistics, automotive SaaS, and high-traffic consumer mobile apps.
journey_desc: 6+ years of engineering progression: architecting microservices, leading cross-functional squads, and shipping production platforms across fintech, enterprise logistics, automotive SaaS, and consumer applications.
timeline_subtitle: Track record of technical leadership and core architectural impact across 7 technology companies.

autoqual.summary: Spearheaded technical operations and end-to-end system architecture, shipping enterprise automotive service workflow platforms, automated vehicle tracking, and multi-warehouse parts inventory management across service centers.
achievements: Architected and shipped real-time vehicle diagnostics and service tracking portals, eliminating manual dispatch bottlenecks across regional service hubs.
Designed normalized relational schemas in PostgreSQL and automated multi-warehouse parts replenishment workflows.
Established team-wide engineering standards, modular API blueprints, and automated continuous deployment pipelines.

sabil.summary: Architected and scaled high-throughput microservices powering mission-critical digital wallet transactions and multi-tenant banking operations.
achievements: Architected distributed, fault-tolerant microservices with NestJS and Redis handling high-concurrency payment transactions with zero transaction loss.
Optimized PostgreSQL partitioning, indexing, and asynchronous event streams to achieve sub-45ms P99 transaction confirmation latencies.
Engineered multi-channel payment reconciliation workflows with strict idempotency, audit trails, and automated settlement verification.

finnetude.summary: Directed engineering squads across the SDLC to architect and ship real-time electronic stock trading and interactive multi-asset market simulation platforms.
achievements: Led a cross-functional squad of 6 engineers to architect and ship InvestMarket (real-time stock trading & portfolio platform) and ALFA+ (digital trading academy and market simulator).
Decomposed monolithic legacy systems into elastic event-driven microservices, achieving fault isolation and 99.9% production uptime.
Architected bidirectional WebSocket streaming infrastructure delivering sub-5ms latency for tick-by-tick order-book execution and live candlestick market feeds.

instaclean.concurrentNote: Concurrent with early 2024 automotive platform development
instaclean.summary: Engineered an on-demand mobile car wash ordering and fleet management platform connecting service agents directly with vehicle owners.
achievements: Built reactive Flutter cross-platform mobile architecture featuring real-time GPS fleet tracking, automated geofencing dispatch algorithms, and offline request queuing.
Engineered custom 60fps UI component interactions and persistent local caching layers resilient to unstable network conditions.
Configured automated push notifications and transactional alerts using Firebase Cloud Messaging.

kabri-auto.concurrentNote: Concurrent with early 2024 mobile application development
kabri-auto.summary: Architected a high-volume cross-border e-commerce platform for automotive replacement parts launched in Dubai (UAE market).
achievements: Built parts compatibility indexing engine matching 10,000+ complex OEM vehicle specifications with aftermarket replacement inventory.
Developed multi-currency checkout workflows, dynamic shipping calculation APIs, and automated multi-warehouse synchronization.

piassa-dz.summary: Architected B2B SaaS automotive ecosystem, customer engagement CRM, and real-time supplier catalog synchronization APIs.
achievements: Developed high-conversion responsive client portals and mobile features for automotive suppliers and auto mechanics.
Architected full-fledged CRM automating supplier quotations, purchase orders, and garage inventory alerts, cutting quotation turnaround time by 65%.
Created high-throughput bidirectional synchronization APIs connecting central Piassa catalog database with distributed client POS systems.

bfln-technologies.summary: Spearheaded development and deployment of omnichannel order tracking and call center management systems.
achievements: Spearheaded the complete development and rollout of an omnichannel order tracking and call center telephony routing system.
Automated customer service operations, reducing manual dispatch times by 40% and eliminating logistics bottlenecks.
Engineered normalized relational database schemas, complex reporting aggregation queries, and real-time operator telemetry dashboards.
